name: DCA Clarabelle's Hand-Dipped Vanilla Ice Cream Bar (Milk Chocolate Coating)
brandOrRestaurant: Clarabelle's Hand-Scooped Ice Cream (Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Handmade ice cream bar on a wooden stick dipped fresh in warm milk chocolate. Seed-free and nut-free when ordered with chocolate crunch or Mickey sprinkles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order vanilla ice cream bar dipped in milk chocolate with sprinkles (avoid whole roasted nuts or berry toppings).
watchOuts: Contains dairy cream and milk chocolate; take lactase enzymes if lactose sensitive
